tasks.subject: Phase 4: Playback Engine + layer hide-not-unmount
tasks.description:
Implement Phase 4 of the timetravel feature:
1. Create src/recording/interpolate.ts (lerp, lerpAngle, findBracket)
2. Create src/recording/PlaybackEngine.ts (frame loading, rAF loop, handle registry)
3. Modify LayerRenderer.tsx and GroundLayer.tsx for hide-not-unmount pattern
4. Modify per-layer files: PlaneLayer, ShipLayer, SatelliteLayer, SeismicLayer
5. Create tests: interpolate.test.ts, playback-engine.test.ts, layer-hidden.test.ts
6. Run all tests
7. git commit Phase 4 changes
8. Update plan.md checkboxes for Phase 4 tasks
